clauses.quoted_text: Seller reserves the right to apply a tariff surcharge to invoices for products subject to additional import duties, in an amount not to exceed the duties actually paid. The surcharge will be shown as a separate line on the invoice.
clauses.reasoning: Section 4 permits Seller to bill a tariff surcharge capped at duties paid, but says nothing about refunds of duties. No text requires Seller to pass a refund to Buyer, and none states that no refund is owed, so the refund question is unresolved on the face of the contract.
